title: AUTHORIZATION.as_str().to_string() allocates on every auth_header call
description: auth.rs lines 159 and 212: AUTHORIZATION.as_str().to_string() is called inside auth_header() on every HTTP request. AUTHORIZATION is a reqwest::header::HeaderName constant; its as_str() returns &'static str "authorization". Using a string literal constant or storing it in the struct at construction would avoid the per-call allocation. Idiomatic fix: return ("authorization".to_owned(), self.header_string.clone()) or better, change the return type to borrow from self as described in the AuthProvider issue.
